logline: 폐렴으로 누운 처녀가 창밖 담쟁이 잎을 세며 마지막 잎이 지면 자기도 간다고 말한다.
destination: 창밖 벽돌담의 마지막 잎 하나 — 밤새 비바람이 몰아치는 자리
protagonist: 창백한 얼굴에 긴 갈색 머리를 늘어뜨린 스물세 살 처녀
anchor: a pale young woman of twenty-three with long brown hair, in a white nightgown
palette: grey rain light, brick red, worn ochre, warm lamp glow, cold window blue

sick_girl.label: 병든 처녀
sick_girl.desc: a pale young woman of twenty-three, long brown hair loose on the pillow, white nightgown, thin hands

friend.label: 친구 화가
friend.desc: a young woman of twenty-five, dark hair pinned up, paint-stained smock over a plain blouse

old_painter.label: 늙은 화가
old_painter.desc: a stooped man in his sixties, shaggy white beard, paint-spattered shirt, heavy boots

attic_room.label: 다락방
attic_room.desc: a cramped studio attic, iron bed by a window, easel and paint jars, bare board floor

brick_wall.label: 창밖 벽돌담
brick_wall.desc: a bare brick wall across a narrow yard, an old ivy vine climbing it, few leaves left

beats.visual: a pale young woman propped in an iron bed counting something beyond a rain-streaked window
beats.motion: her lips move as she counts, rain runs down the glass, the lamp flame wavers

beats.beat: 창밖 담쟁이에 잎이 몇 남지 않았다.
beats.visual: an old ivy vine on a bare brick wall with only a handful of leaves left, grey rain
beats.motion: the remaining leaves shake in the rain, one tears loose and drops away

beats.visual: a young woman in a paint-stained smock leaning over an iron bed toward a pale patient
beats.motion: she bends closer to the bed, her hand closes on the blanket, lamplight shifts

beats.visual: a young woman speaking to a bearded old man in a cluttered downstairs studio, canvases stacked
beats.motion: her hands lift as she speaks, he turns toward her, dust drifts in the lamplight

beats.visual: a brick wall lashed by night rain and wind, ivy thrashing, one lit window across the yard
beats.motion: wind drives the rain across the wall, the vine whips, the window light flickers

beats.beat: 아침에 처녀가 커튼을 걷어 달라 한다.
beats.visual: a pale young woman raised on one elbow as a curtain is drawn back from a morning window
beats.motion: the curtain slides open, grey light spreads across the bed, she lifts her head

beats.beat: 담벼락에 잎 하나가 그대로 붙어 있다.
beats.visual: a single ivy leaf still clinging to a wet brick wall after a storm, everything else bare
beats.motion: the last leaf holds against the wind, water runs down the bricks, mist lifts

beats.beat: 빈 다락 창가에 아침 빛만 든다.
beats.visual: an empty attic window seat in morning light, a folded blanket, an easel in shadow
beats.motion: morning light creeps across the floor, dust turns in the beam, the curtain stirs

withheld: 마지막 잎의 정체와, 그것을 그린 사람에게 일어난 일
